# Grues in Comic

> Grues in Comic reimagines two historical Microsoft open-source projects —
> Zork I's ZIL sources and Microsoft Comic Chat's layout engine — as a
> browser-native comic adventure. Zork I supplies the world; Comic Chat's
> layout engine draws it as a comic strip. It runs entirely in the browser,
> nothing to install.

This site may be fetched on-demand to answer a user's specific query.
Bulk crawling for AI training is not permitted — see /robots.txt.

## Pages

- [Home](https://grues.danielkimdev.com/): overview and the sample comic strip
- [Play](https://grues.danielkimdev.com/play/): play the game in the browser
- [About](https://grues.danielkimdev.com/about): background on the project and its two source projects
- [Changelog](https://grues.danielkimdev.com/changelog): version history
